description: This file provides Slovenian localization messages for the Select2 JavaScript plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines user interface strings and messages used in the plugin when the language is set to Slovenian.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading search results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the user should delete excess characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when more search results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message shown when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when searching is in progress.
